title: Make No Mistakes · Alex’s 9 AM Demo
premise: A message in a tiny backpack carries Alex’s broken login through the system before his morning demo.

scenes.anchor: How does OpenAI handle over 2.5 billion messages a day?
scenes.description: A dimensional OpenAI knot fills as requests arrive. It opens and drops one gold request into Astra’s hand.
scenes.label: hook

scenes.anchor: This is Alex's message. It has one job: get to me and back before his demo.
scenes.description: At 2:13 AM Alex sends login-01 before his 9:00 AM demo.
scenes.label: setup

scenes.anchor: First stop, Cloudflare, then a checkpoint: who are you, and have you hit your limit?
scenes.description: The courier presents its ID at the Cloudflare gate. The ID receives a stamp, then the gate shows one request left.
scenes.label: gate

scenes.anchor: Inside, his message gets chopped into tokens. 'Make no mistakes' is three. In caps it'd be six. Yelling costs double.
scenes.description: The same message opens its three token blocks and compares six in caps.
scenes.label: tokens

scenes.anchor: Then it waits for a spot in a batch with other requests, and I write the answer one token at a time.
scenes.description: The brightly lit GPU slot empties and the waiting gold request lands inside it.
scenes.label: gpu

scenes.anchor: Each piece ships as it's ready. That's why Alex watches it type out.
scenes.description: Pieces of the reply travel from the GPU to the editor on Alex’s laptop.
scenes.label: stream

scenes.anchor: On the way out, it gets saved. ChatGPT's core PostgreSQL database has one main server taking all the writes.
scenes.description: One primary records the write. The saved state remains while Astra reacts.
scenes.label: database

scenes.anchor: And… it's still broken. Because to me, 'make no mistakes' was just three more tokens.
scenes.description: At 2:41 AM the first fix produces a red error. Alex reads the missing email field.
scenes.label: failure

scenes.anchor: OpenAI's GPT-5 launch post says 'think hard about this' can route you to a thinking model.
scenes.description: Astra reads the four replacement words as they appear. The thinking route reveals the corrected email field.
scenes.label: retry

scenes.anchor: ...Not that I'm telling you what to type.
scenes.description: With his login working, Alex rests his forehead on his desk. Astra faces front for her last line.
scenes.label: aside
